chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: You are approaching a "red" traffic light. Several cars are waiting in all lanes. What do you do?

options.text: Wait in your lane behind the last car
Pass the waiting cars on the right-hand side and proceed to the stop line
Pass the waiting cars on the left-hand side and proceed to the stop line

correct_answers.text: Wait in your lane behind the last car

comment: You should always wait in line behind the last car in your lane and not try to pass over other cars by either side.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: Which motor vehicles may freely choose their lane inside built-up areas?
comment: In Germany, the legal driving requirement applies. Vehicles up to 3.5 tons are excluded from the right-hand drive requirement within built-up areas and can freely choose their lane.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: What is the right course of action now?

options.text: I move into the right-hand lane
I stay in the centre lane
I move into the left-hand lane

correct_answers.text: I move into the right-hand lane

comment: In Germany, you must drive on the right. As there is no vehicle in front of you that is travelling slower than you, you must move into the right lane. As soon as slower vehicles appear, you may move back into the centre or left lane to overtake them.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: How could a dangerous situation arise?

options.text: - yellow truck
- green truck
- the car up ahead

comment: The fast driving style of the yellow truck suggests that he will overtake the blue truck in front of him as well. Their speed is faster than that of the trucks. You cannot dodge to the left as a car on the left lane is directly behind you. If the yellow truck swings out, you have to brake hard.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles

options.text: I let the blue car merge in front of me
I accelerate
I immediately change from the left lane to the central lane

correct_answers.text: I let the blue car merge in front of me

comment: Since the driver of the car on the right of the acceleration lane increases its speed, you should enable him/her to merge into traffic. Refrain from your right of way and reduce your own speed. You cannot change on the left lane as a vehicle approaches there.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles

options.text: I stay in the middle lane and slow down
I move to the right-hand lane and slow down
I move into the left-hand lane and overtake the red car in front of me

correct_answers.text: I stay in the middle lane and slow down

comment: Stay on the middle lane and delay. The leading car will also delay soon to let the car on the left lane merge into traffic, because this lane ends. You cannot go to the left, changing to the right lane would be too dangerous as well.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: What is the right course of action?

options.text: I reduce my speed
I continue driving without changing speed
I move into the right-hand lane

comment: You drive on the middle lane and in this situation you have to stay on the lane and reduce the speed. The driver on the left lane drives more slowly. You must not overtake him from the right. You cannot change to the right lane, there is a vehicle.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: What must you anticipate in this situation?

options.text: - grey car will move into the middle lane
- yellow truck will pull out in front of me to overtake
- grey car will remain in the right-hand lane

correct_answers.text: - grey car will move into the middle lane

comment: Since the vehicle drives very fast from the right onto the freeway, you have to expect that it will change to the middle lane. This impression is reinforced by the fact that trucks maintain their speed and distance.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: What is the right course of action?

options.text: I reduce my speed and stay in the middle lane
I maintain my speed and stay in the middle lane
I maintain my speed and move into the right-hand lane

correct_answers.text: I reduce my speed and stay in the middle lane

comment: A car drives in front of you and from the right a car drives onto the main carriageway of the freeway. It is clear that the car driving on the left lane has a slower pace than you. Since it's only allowed to overtake on the left, you must delay and reduce your speed.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: You are driving on a road that has several marked lanes going in one direction. When should the alternate merging procedure be employed?

options.text: When a lane comes to an end
If one lane is not continuously free to traffic due to an obstacle
When a merging lane ends on the motorway

correct_answers.text: When a lane comes to an end
If one lane is not continuously free to traffic due to an obstacle

comment: The zipper merge is to be used when a lane cannot be used any further. The exception is on the motorway.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: What is true about using the hard shoulder in this situation?

options.text: - must be used like a right-hand lane
- may only be used in a breakdown situation
- may only be used by trucks

correct_answers.text: - must be used like a right-hand lane

comment: The traffic sign indicates that the hard shoulder is to be used like the right-hand lane.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: What is true in this situation about using the hard shoulder?

options.text: – may only be used in the case of a breakdown
– may only be used by trucks
– must be used in the same way as a right-hand lane

correct_answers.text: – may only be used in the case of a breakdown

comment: The hard shoulder may not be used regularly. You can only use it in case of a breakdown.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: What is the right behaviour now?

options.text: I reduce my speed
I let the [blue] car in front of me move over
I accelerate

correct_answers.text: I let the [blue] car in front of me move over

comment: If one of the lanes ends on a multi-lane road, vehicles must be allowed to move to the adjacent lane. Here it is important to drive with foresight in order to be able to react to lane changes in a timely manner and to adjust your own speed if necessary.

chapter_name: Use Of Lanes By Motor Vehicles
question_text: What applies to this road that is outside of a built-up area?

options.text: - to perform a left turn
- to overtake
- if there is a traffic jam

comment:
This traffic sign draws you aware that you will have to choose a direction shortly. At the same time, you will receive an idea of ​​the intersection, especially the turning traces.
Therefore, you can only use the left lanes outside if you want to turn left.
